reviews.title: Highway Robbery
reviews.text:
This is the most ridiculously priced app I have ever encountered.  I signed up for a promotion and never got around to using it.  

Signed up in late April and by late July, I was paying $50/month.  For what? I can’t imagine any kind of self-improvement being worth that kind of cash. 

I’ve used this app maybe one time in 90 days so I can’t rate anything else in terms of usability or user interface. I’m disgusted by the exorbitant cost and disinterested in whatever it could do to help me improve my habits.
